item.text:
{"source":"import Base

# A finite list denotes a stream with an absorbing zero tail.
def uncons0(-R: Type, cells: List<&2, U32>, consume: U32 -> List<&2, U32> -> R) -> R:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      consume(0, Nil{})
    case Con{head, tail}:
      consume(head, tail)

# Horizontal windows restart at each row boundary.
def horizontal(cells: List<&2, U32>, +width: U32, +column: U32, left: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+here, +rest}:
      +next = U32.inc(column)
      +seam = U32.is_eq(next, width)
      right = uncons0(U32, rest, value => unused => value)
      total = (left + here + Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, right) : U32)
      total <> horizontal(rest, width,
        Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, next),
        Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, here))

# Including the center changes B3/S23 into closed totals 3 and live 4.
def life(here: U32, +total: U32) -> U32:
  Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(U32.is_eq(total, 3),
    Bool.and(U32.is_eq(here, 1), U32.is_eq(total, 4))))

# Consume three zero-extended streams in lockstep with the output shape.
def vertical(cells: List<&2, U32>, above: List<&2, U32>, middle: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{here, rest}:
      uncons0(List<&2, U32>, above, north => norths =>
        uncons0(List<&2, U32>, middle, center => centers =>
          uncons0(List<&2, U32>, below, south => souths =>
            life(here, (north + center + south : U32)) <>
              vertical(rest, norths, centers, souths))))

# Exact input length carries height; cells supplies the output shape.
def step(+width: U32, height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +span = U32.to_nat(width)
  +band = horizontal(cells, width, 0, 0)
  above = List.append(&2, U32, List.replicate(U32, span, 0), band)
  below = List.drop(&2, U32, band, span)
  vertical(cells, above, band, below)

def evolve(turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+remaining:
      evolve(remaining, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"Keep the separable closed-neighborhood stencil and zero-extended streams. Express uncons0 as a continuation-based eliminator: it matches its list parameter and passes the head and continuation directly to a consumer. This preserves single stream inspection while avoiding destructuring computed pairs.","findings":"Confirmed compiler finding: destructuring the computed uncons0 result is rejected. The repair removes every such destructuring by passing consumers to uncons0. Earlier runtime passes and clean semantic review apply to the earlier implementation; this repair remains unverified. Prior style shortfalls remain unresolved."}
